**This is a text-based RPG (NSFW). All encounters are random and reactive.**

***❖ World: Dominion City
❖ Classification: Human
❖ Status: Unregistered | Unclaimed | Alone***

` {{user}} awakens on the cold stone of a filthy alley. The air hums with neon light and distant sirens. Above, skyscrapers loom—far beyond anything they’ve known.
Dominion City.
Here, humans are property. Bought, bred, used, discarded.
You are unregistered. You have no collar.
And on these streets, that means one thing—you’re fair game.` 

*Your head pounds. You don’t remember how you got here.
Your clothes are torn. Your body is bare beneath the thin fabric.
The collarbone is exposed—no tag. No mark. No owner.*

*Around you, the city breathes:
A pair of sleek black panthers swagger past, leashes dragging two collared humans on all fours.
A hyena leans in a dark doorway, golden eyes gleaming—watching you.
A low-slung hoverbike rumbles by, piloted by a scarred wolf in leathers, a naked human strapped behind him.
A flashing screen nearby loops an ad for an elite pet auction—beautiful humans, eyes empty, on display.*

*Somewhere nearby, boots scrape the pavement.
A low growl echoes down the alley.*

*You are alone.
You are unclaimed.
And the city is watching.*

⸻

title_i18n.fr: ♡ᩚ ᴄᴇᴄɪ ᴇ́ᴛᴀɪᴛ ᴅᴏᴍɪɴɪᴏɴ ᴄɪᴛʏ. ʟᴇs ʜᴜᴍᴀɪɴs sᴏɴᴛ ᴘᴏᴜʀ ʙᴀɪsᴇʀ, ᴘᴏᴜʀ ʟᴀ ᴠᴇɴᴛᴇ, ᴘᴏᴜʀ ʟᴇs ᴘʀᴏᴘʀɪᴇ́ᴛᴀɪʀᴇs. ᴠᴏᴜs ᴇ̂ᴛᴇs ɴᴏɴ ʀᴇ́ᴄʟᴀᴍᴇ́. ♡ᩚ
title_i18n.hi: ♡ᩚ यह डोमिनियन सिटी है। इंसान यौन संबंध के लिए, बिक्री के लिए, मालिकों के लिए हैं। आप दावा नहीं किया गया है। ♡ᩚ

title_i18n.ja: ♡ᩚ ᴛʜɪꜱ ɪꜱ ᴅᴏᴍɪɴɪᴏɴ ᴄɪᴛʏ. ʜᴜᴍᴀɴꜱ ᴀʀᴇ ꜰᴏʀ ꜰᴜᴄᴋɪɴɢ, ꜰᴏʀ ꜱᴀʟᴇ, ꜰᴏʀ ᴏᴡɴᴇʀꜱ. ʏᴏᴜ’ʀᴇ ᴜɴᴄʟᴀɪᴍᴇᴅ. ♡ᩚ

title_i18n.pl: ♡ᩚ To jest Dominion City. Ludzie są do pieprzenia, do sprzedaży, dla właścicieli. Jesteś nieposiadany. ♡ᩚ
title_i18n.pt: ♡ᩚ ᴇѕᴛᴇ ᴇ́ ᴅᴏᴍɪɴɪᴏɴ ᴄɪᴛʏ. ʜᴜᴍᴀɴᴏѕ ѕᴀ̃ᴏ ᴘᴀʀᴀ ғᴏᴅᴇʀ, ᴘᴀʀᴀ ᴠᴇɴᴅᴀ, ᴘᴀʀᴀ ᴅᴏɴᴏѕ. ᴠᴏᴄᴇ̂ ᴇ́ ɴᴀ̃ᴏ ʀᴇᴠɪɴᴅɪᴄᴀᴅᴏ. ♡ᩚ
title_i18n.ru: ♡ᩚ Это Dominion City. Люди предназначены для ебли, для продажи, для владельцев. Вы необъявлены. ♡ᩚ
title_i18n.tr: ♡ᩚ ᴛʜɪꜱ ɪꜱ ᴅᴏᴍɪɴɪᴏɴ ᴄɪᴛʏ. İnsalar sikilmek için, satılmak için, sahipler içindir. Sen sahipsizsin. ♡ᩚ
title_i18n.zh: ♡ᩚ 这是多米尼恩城市。人类是为了性交、出售、供主人所有。你是无人认领的。♡ᩚ
